silhouette.reason: A stepped test-card stand: rows of strip panels rising to the back, decal and foliage cells on top; every panel visible from the 3/4 view.
fixes: separate the rows by a thin gap so the steps read in the SIDE view

proportions.reason: Each strip one true-scale repeat wide, so texel density is judged directly.
fixes: add a 1.8 m figure at the front row as a scale reference

materials.reason: In hero.png the strips render with their own albedo/normal/ORM: wood grain, cobbles, cliff, grass, glass; in sheet.png most strips render flat grey.
fixes: add a sphere per strip at LOD0 for curvature/roughness reading

detail.reason: Labels on every plinth face; at hero distance the labels are unreadable.
fixes: scale label pixel size with the row panel width

wear.reason: A test card is clean by design; weathering variants live in weather_demo.
fixes: a worn variant row showing each strip with its grime pass

lod.reason: LOD2 keeps every panel but drops labels.
fixes: keep row labels as one quad per label at LOD1

technical.reason: QA clean; 27k / 778 / 778 tris (labels are the LOD0 cost), 132 parts.
fixes: merge label pixel runs per word to cut LOD0 triangles
